subsystems.name: Microphone array
subsystems.role: Captures speech from the wearer and the person they are talking to, even in noisy places.

subsystems.name: Speech recognition
subsystems.role: Converts the captured audio into text in the source language.

subsystems.name: Translation engine
subsystems.role: Translates the text into the target language.

subsystems.name: Speech synthesis
subsystems.role: Turns the translated text into natural-sounding speech.

subsystems.name: Audio output
subsystems.role: Plays the translated speech into the user's ear.

subsystems.name: Connectivity and compute
subsystems.role: Links the earbuds to a phone or cloud and runs the AI models.

subsystems.name: Power and controls
subsystems.role: Powers the earbuds and lets the user control translation.

buildSteps.title: Train the AI models
buildSteps.detail: Collect thousands of hours of transcribed speech and parallel text for many language pairs; train speech recognition, translation and speech synthesis models.

buildSteps.title: Design the acoustic hardware
buildSteps.detail: Choose microphones and speakers, design beamforming and noise cancellation to isolate the speaker's voice, and fit everything into a small earbud.

buildSteps.title: Select the compute platform
buildSteps.detail: Decide which models run on the earbud, on a paired phone, or in the cloud; choose a low-power chip with an AI accelerator for on-device tasks.

buildSteps.title: Develop firmware and app
buildSteps.detail: Write the real-time audio pipeline that streams audio, runs inference and plays back the translation with minimal delay; build a companion app for language selection.

buildSteps.title: Manufacture components
buildSteps.detail: Produce printed circuit boards, drivers, batteries and plastic shells; assemble earbuds with pick-and-place machines and soldering.

buildSteps.title: Calibrate and test
buildSteps.detail: Test each unit for audio quality, latency and translation accuracy across accents and noisy environments.

buildSteps.title: Package and deploy
buildSteps.detail: Pair earbuds with a charging case and mobile app; continue to update models over the air to improve language coverage.

prerequisites.why: Needed to turn spoken words into text accurately.
Needed to translate text between languages with good fluency.
Needed to speak the translation naturally.
Needed to connect earbuds to phone or cloud without noticeable delay.
Needed for offline use and lower latency without a phone.

pathway.milestone: Earbuds translate major languages with a phone or cloud connection, often with a slight delay.
pathway.unlocks: Basic conversation for travel and simple business.

pathway.milestone: Fully on-device translation with sub-second latency.
pathway.unlocks: Offline use, better privacy, and more natural back-and-forth.

pathway.milestone: Multi-speaker translation that identifies who is speaking.
Translation that preserves tone, humor and cultural nuance.
